jig_ims_case_study.title: Jig Inventory Management System
jig_ims_case_study.intro: A web-based solution to manage jig inventory using QR code technology for real-time tracking of location, transactions and availability.
jig_ims_case_study.challenge_text: The project started when I joined the Production Planning Engineer department. By analyzing their entire workflow, I identified a critical bottleneck: Analog Management. With over 12,500 jigs moving through the facility, relying on human memory and scattered Excel files guaranteed data failure. This 'Invisible Capital Waste' led to 10-15 minutes wasted per shift searching for misplaced tooling, production delays affecting Machine OEE, and the unnecessary remanufacturing of jigs that already existed but couldn't be found.
jig_ims_case_study.feature1_desc: Quick identification and access. Track current location and movement history.
jig_ims_case_study.feature2_desc: Dashboard with search, filter, and reports. Log every in/out, transfer, or status change.
jig_ims_case_study.feature3_desc: Role-based access and data security for factory-wide use.
jig_ims_case_study.outcome_text:
By implementing this system, we created a true Paradigm Shift from 'Analog Chaos' to 'Digital Order':

• Process Collapse: Reduced operations from 11 manual steps to just 4 digital clicks.
• Speed to Locate: Slashed search times from 10-15 minutes to <10 seconds via the Web Dashboard.
• Data Accuracy: Replaced conflicting Excel sheets with a Single Source of Truth Database.
• Accountability: Enforced role-based digital custody via QR scan—'Whoever's name is on the dashboard physically owns the tool.'

Driven by 3 Core Pillars—the Web Application (The Brain), Physical QR Tags (The Bridge), and Leader Accountability (The Culture)—the system successfully eliminated unnecessary capital waste and optimized factory-wide operational visibility.

Proven Business Impact at Mattel Bangkok (MBK):
• 60% Time Reduction: Time spent in searching and tracking reduced from hours to under 10 seconds per transaction.
• 0 Phantom Losses: Real-time visibility eliminates the accidental re-purchasing of existing, misplaced jigs.
• 1 Single Source of Truth: Eliminated conflicting Excel files across Engineering, Production, and Planning departments.
